highlights.title: Gemini on your Google subscription
highlights.line: Sign in on Google's own page, and Gemini gets its own row in AI Models.

highlights.title: See what your Gemini agents are doing
highlights.line: Gemini agents on a Google subscription can now show Working, Idle or Needs you on their card.

highlights.title: A simpler Kosmos Plus page
highlights.line: One switch to pause Kosmos Plus, one box that says where to sign in, and a way to remove this computer.

highlights.title: A clearer Tasks page
highlights.line: Every task grouped by where the work is, each status with its own icon, and Needs Your Decision in red.
